message:
v2.0.1

Patch: v2.0.0 was accidentally SSH-signed, not gitsign-signed (a global git config default this
repo's local config had lost after a fresh reclone) -- gitsign verify-tag fails on it with
'unsupported signature type'. No policy content change from v2.0.0. Same pattern as v1.0.0 -> v1.0.1:
v2.0.0 stays as an honest record of the mistake (the tag-immutability ruleset blocks moving it
regardless), v2.0.1 is the first properly gitsign-signed major-2 release.
